_about: How the coverage lens measures what is known about a footprint. It counts the controlled assets by type and checks each kind of gap named in gaps: names with no stored address or alias, registered domains with no stored registration record, netblocks with no registration, addresses not placed in a netblock, and assets not seen within stale_days of the last time the subject was seen. Each gap says what collection would fill it. Add values here, not in Go code.

gaps.names_without_address: Names were stored without being resolved; an enumeration that resolves DNS (active or passive DNS sources) fills them.
gaps.domains_without_registration: No RDAP or WHOIS record was stored for these domains; enabling the registration (RDAP/WHOIS) data sources fills them.
gaps.netblocks_without_registration: No RDAP record names who holds these netblocks; the RDAP data sources fill them.
gaps.addresses_without_netblock: These addresses were never placed in a netblock or autonomous system; network (ASN/BGP) data sources fill them.
gaps.stale_assets: These were not seen again by the latest enumeration of the subject; re-enumerating shows whether they are gone.
